newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Metro Pacific down 6.45 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Metro Pacific down 6.45 pct in late trade.

text.p: Metro Pacific Corp fell 40 centavos, or 6.45 percent, to 5.80 pesos on late Wednesday trade on concerns it may experience funding problems with its growing stake in Bonifacio Land Corp.

"There is this concern on Metro's funding sources. They will have to pay an amount bigger than the 1.6 billion pesos they had to pay for this year's cash call in Bonifacio Land with their bigger stake," Alexis Cabel, analyst at Angping Securities, said.

Metro Pacific announced last week that it had bought Filinvest Group's 16 percent stake in Bonifacio Land, a joint venture with government to develop a 214-hectare lot at the edge of the Manila's financial district. The purchase amounted to 5.36 billion pesos.
"People may be wondering how Metro Pacific will be able to raise financing for their bigger equity," Henry Ong, analyst at Sapphire Securities, said.
Metro Pacific said the concerns were without basis. "The fears are quite unfounded ... There's absolutely no basis for concern," Seumas Gallacher, director at Metro Pacific, said.
Metro Pacific said on Tuesday it had seen strong buying interest for its high-end condominiums at Bonifacio city.
